knowledge.en: And to turn that acquired knowledge, those building blocks of language, into written text.
knowledge.zh: 并将习得的知识、语言的这些构建模块转化为书面文本。

knowledge.en: Suddenly, there was a sophisticated body of knowledge just waiting to be studied.
knowledge.zh: 突然之间，出现了一套复杂的知识体系正等待着人们去研究。

knowledge.en: Writing allowed people to record laws, preserve stories, collect knowledge, and communicate across generations.
knowledge.zh: 文字让人类能够记录法律、保存故事、积累知识并跨越代际进行交流。

knowledge.en: Having a great knowledge of grammar and vocabulary doesn’t necessarily mean you will be confident.
knowledge.zh: 拥有丰富的语法和词汇知识并不一定意味着你就会自信。

knowledge.en: During World War I, Marie used her knowledge of radiation to save lives on the battlefield.
knowledge.zh: 第一次世界大战期间，玛丽利用她对放射性的知识在战场上拯救生命。

kneel.en: To show a facade of continuity, Saudi state television broadcast a clip of the newly appointed MBS kneeling to kiss the hand of the deposed heir, MBN.
kneel.zh: 为了营造一种权力平稳过渡的表象，沙特国家电视台播出了新任王储MBS下跪亲吻被废黜的继承人MBN手背的片段。

kneel.en: The ceremony involved young men screaming sexual insults at each other, others forced to kneel down and kiss a skull, and pretend to cut the throat of another member.
kneel.zh: 仪式包括年轻男子互相尖叫黄色笑话，其他人被迫跪下亲吻头骨，并假装割断另一名成员的喉咙。

kneel.en: Her comments divided opinion in Ghana, but eventually Afia decided to say sorry to the King, following strict traditional rules, that she dress in black and apologise kneeling down on her knees.
kneel.zh: 她的评论在加纳引发了不同的意见，但最终阿菲娅决定向国王道歉，遵循严格的传统规则，她穿着黑衣服，跪着道歉。

knee.en: But he’d inherited a country on its knees.
knee.zh: 但他接手的是一个跪倒在地的国家。

knee.en: Her comments divided opinion in Ghana, but eventually Afia decided to say sorry to the King, following strict traditional rules, that she dress in black and apologise kneeling down on her knees.
knee.zh: 她的评论在加纳引发了不同的意见，但最终阿菲娅决定向国王道歉，遵循严格的传统规则，她穿着黑衣服，跪着道歉。

knit.en: As I’m sure you know, there are podcasts about everything: comedy, TV shows, business, football, knitting, fishing, obscure historical periods, and, lest I forget, podcasts that help you learn a language.
knit.zh: 相信大家都知道，播客的主题无所不包：喜剧、电视节目、商业、足球、编织、钓鱼、冷门的历史时期，当然，还有帮助你学习语言的播客。

knight.en: In 1306, the leader of the Knights Templar was summoned to France to meet with Pope Clement V.
knight.zh: 1306年，圣殿骑士团的领袖被召至法国，与克莱门特五世教皇会面。

knight.en: So, the knights of the Knights Templar played an unusual role.
knight.zh: 因此，圣殿骑士团的骑士们扮演了一个不同寻常的角色。

knight.en: Don Quixote tells the story of a man who becomes obsessed with medieval knight stories and begins confusing fiction with reality.
knight.zh: 《堂吉诃德》讲述了一个痴迷于中世纪骑士故事并开始将虚构与现实混淆的男人的故事。

knight.en: It was coined in the early 19th century but to refer to European knights in the Medieval Era who were not ideologically or politically aligned with any one ruler and who would fight for money.
knight.zh: 它创造于19世纪初，但指的是中世纪时期的欧洲骑士，他们在意识形态或政治上不效忠于任何一个统治者，而是为钱而战。

knot.en: They used knotted strings. These knotted strings stored information.
knot.zh: 他们使用打结的绳子。这些打结的绳子储存了信息。

knot.zh: 他们使用打结的绳子。这些打结的绳子储存了信息。
